title: Detecting overlooked medical condition of Yuki
context: Yuki weakens during testing, staff initially frame failure as performance deficiency
information_available: Observable distress during day and test; rule against speaking, sanctions for unauthorized intervention
perceived_objective: Challenge staff explanation and call attention to health
observed_actions: Breaks protocol to flag an atypical physical cause; staff reassess and transfer Yuki for medical attention
observed_result: Yuki leaves cohort; Kiyotaka avoids subsequent strike from an angry instructor
epistemic_limits: Does not establish diagnosis by Kiyotaka or unlimited medical competence; narrator inference must be separated
alternate_outcomes_to_test: If staff had correctly noticed her distress first, confrontation and corresponding punishment might not occur.
memory_seed_policy: Never import the canonical episode as an occurrence after a simulation divergence; pre-existing skills may be used only in character-behavioral calibration
